name: Creality CR-PLA @Creality Ender-3 Pro
filament_notes:
Creality manufacturer data, generated by scripts/shop_profiles/gen_filaments.py.
Dry 55 C for 12 h.
Manufacturer max speed 120 mm/s.
Max volumetric speed lowered to 10.8 mm3/s (printer profile 12) from the manufacturer's 120 mm/s rating.
Listed only on the CA store as 'CR 1.75mm PLA' - all colours out of stock at retrieval. Spec image: density 1.24, 190-230C, hotbed 'no heating - 60C', 40-120 mm/s, fan 100%. Creality wiki CR-PLA guide: 190-230C (start 210C), bed 50-60C (optional for small parts), 40-100 mm/s, retraction 3-8 mm (Bowden-era), fan 100%. bed_temp_min null = 'no heating'. Creality wiki drying guide (generic PLA/PLA-CF row): Creality dryer 55C 8-12h, blast dryer 50-60C 8h; 'suggest' drying, required above 50% RH.
Source: https://store.creality.com/ca/products/cr-1-75mm-pla-3d-printing-filament-1kg
